C-EXECUTION-CONTRACT.IntentSummary: Close D11: export the known cursor event-kind set from grace-cursor (minimal; no source parse — F10), add a completeness regression that fails until every exported kind has a structural protocol marker in ngrace-execute, then document all nine kinds plus terminal-before-fold (F12) and attempt-ordering (F9.8) in both skill trees, keeping them byte-identical. Completeness check precedes documentation (red is already real).

T-001.Title: Export known-kind set and red completeness check (before skill docs)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Export: src/grace-cursor.ts exports a runtime known-kind list that is definitionally the keys of KNOWN_KIND_STATE (e.g. KNOWN_EVENT_KINDS = Object.freeze(Object.keys(KNOWN_KIND_STATE) as KnownEventKind[])). A unit assertion shows the export length equals Object.keys(KNOWN_KIND_STATE) and contains every key. No duplicated hand-maintained string array that can drift from the const. MODULE_MAP lists the export. No fold/attempt/recover behaviour change (AC-EXPORT-MINIMAL).

Completeness regression in src/grace-cursor.test.ts **imports** the export (does not parse grace-cursor.ts source — F10). It reads skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md and requires, for every exported kind, a structural marker: `<kind id="KIND">` as a child of a `<cursor_kinds>` block. Incidental English, backticks, or headings without that element do not count.

Red-first and reported count (F12.2): run the completeness test against the current skill **before** T-002 edits the skill. It must **fail**. The failure (or an explicit assertion in the red phase) **reports the missing count and the missing kind ids** — not a bare expect(false). At plan authoring, structural missing is **9 of 9** (measured: zero kind-id markers). Re-measure at execute if the skill changed; do not invent the number. After T-002 documentation, the same test must pass (green in T-003).

Discriminating negatives for AC-KIND-COMPLETENESS-TIED-TO-CODE: (1) a test that only asserts the string "terminal" (or a fixed list disconnected from the export) appears in the skill **fails this criterion** as the implementation of the check; (2) a check that discovers kinds by regex/AST parse of grace-cursor.ts **fails this criterion**; (3) after export exists, adding a hypothetical tenth key to KNOWN_KIND_STATE without a skill marker would fail the suite — assert via the export being the sole denominator (document in test comment if a live tenth key is not injected).

T-002.Title: Document all nine kinds, terminal-before-fold, and F9.8 attempt ordering

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: DependsOn T-001 is binding: documentation lands only after the completeness check exists and has been observed red (T-001). Do not document first and add the check afterward.

AC-KIND-SET-DOCUMENTED — all nine exported kinds receive a `<kind id="…">` entry under `<cursor_kinds>` in skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md, each stating when to emit the kind and what it means (cursor state / lifecycle). **pause and resume require real protocol documentation** — when to emit `cursor advance --kind pause` / `--kind resume`, what state they enter — not reliance on the English already present in execution_rules ("pause/resume around interruptions"). The completeness test from T-001 must pass against the canonical skill after this task (assert via bun test).

AC-TERMINAL-BEFORE-FOLD (verbatim requirement): the skill states that fold requires a terminal event inside the covering allocation (CLI enforces unterminated range otherwise), that the operator emits terminal (e.g. `ngrace cursor advance --kind terminal`) when the epoch's work is finished, and that `recover --fix` does not emit terminal. Reviewer can confirm by reading the skill; agent need not open grace-cursor.ts.

AC-ATTEMPT-ORDERING-F98 (verbatim operational rule): the skill states that for honest red-first, write `ngrace cursor attempt --outcome fail` in its **own tool round trip**, then perform the production edit, then record pass — not in the same batched tool call as the fix. It attaches the reason: WriteEvidence digests ObservedWriteScope at attempt time, so a fail attempt batched with the fix cannot corroborate the sequence. It names the failure shape: `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` on fail→pass pairs with no non-test digest movement, and that an honest disclosed gap is cheap while an unsubstantiated contradiction is not. Inserting only the words "round trip" or "F9.8" without the ordering rule, digest reason, and review failure shape fails this criterion.

AC-NO-SKILL-REWRITE: preflight, assertion_commands, mode_selection, recovery_decision_table, execution_rules, verdicts, and calibration sections remain; this task **adds** cursor_kinds / protocol text and the F12/F9.8 rules without inverting the skill into P1.10 emphasis rewrite or a schema dump. Assert by structure: those section tags still present; no wholesale replacement of execution_rules with a generated catalog.
Edit both skill trees in this task (canonical and packaged mirror) so they stay byte-identical after the write (T-003 re-verifies with cmp and validate-marketplace). Editing only one tree fails.

T-003.Title: Mirror identity, completeness green, suite and lint close

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-MIRROR-BYTE-IDENTICAL: skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md and plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md are byte-identical (`cmp` clean / equal digests). bun run ./scripts/validate-marketplace.ts reports no packaged-vs-canonical skill drift for ngrace-execute.
Completeness regression from T-001 is **green** (all exported kinds have structural markers). Report the denominator from the export (expect 9 at current KNOWN_KIND_STATE) and missing count 0.

AC-SUITE-AND-LINT: bun test for touched packages green; bun run ngrace lint --path . is 0 errors and 0 warnings; bun run validate:ci green. Version surfaces and CHANGELOG.md were not modified by this bundle. No edits under docs/plans/archive/ or .ngrace/changes/archive/.
